source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL sends the correct raw bytes through sshpass/host-key bypass, sleeps a fixed 90 seconds and checks only `mc info`.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires explicit approval, exact target, independent reset/recovery observation, MAC/IP/config and host-power invariants, protected access and no retry.

old_problem: The historical record retained Pending for cold-reset behavior, readiness timeout, independent recovery and before/after invariants. IPMI defines App NetFn 0x06 command 0x02 as Cold Reset of the responding management controller and distinguishes it from Warm Reset; target-specific recovery time and services are bounded Project inputs rather than missing command semantics.
disposition_reason: Issue the exact raw cold-reset command once after explicit approval, using a verified protected localhost/in-band path. Independent monitors must prove a genuine BMC reset/outage and complete readiness, unchanged MAC/IP/persistent network identity, functional required management services, and no host power or boot transition. Preserve logs before the reset; fixed sleep, ping or one `mc info` call is insufficient, and the adjacent warm-reset variant cannot supply evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 993, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 994 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 994 / variant b804dc50fc09ee4a.

IPMI v2.0 section 20.2 defines Cold Reset as resetting the responder and restoring interrupt enables, event generation, sensor scanning, threshold and other power-up-default internal state. It is a management-controller reset, not a host cold boot or power cycle.

Section 20.3 defines Warm Reset separately as internal-state/interface cleanup. Raw 0x06/0x02 therefore must remain distinct from raw 0x06/0x03 and cannot borrow the following case's downtime or evidence.

Command completion only confirms request handling; source Criteria require post-reset BMC functionality, MAC/IP persistence and host-power invariance. These require pre/post comparison and a monitor independent of the resetting in-band channel.

ED-06, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-28 and ED-30 preserve exact reset identity, complete evidence, recovery and no retry; ED-33 through ED-38 allow parameterized execution only with protected access and explicit confirmation.

test_case.test_name: Verify one in-band IPMI BMC cold reset with full management recovery and unchanged host state
test_case.purpose: Verify one standard in-band Cold Reset reinitializes the exact BMC and returns all required management functions with the same MAC/IP and persistent configuration while the SUT host power and boot state remain unchanged.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/local-IPMI/management-endpoint identity, supported BMC firmware and pinned ipmitool/parser/reviewed Script revision
Baseline BMC Get Device ID, MAC, IPv4/IPv6/VLAN/channel configuration, certificate/endpoint identity, required IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/SOL services, health and preserved SEL/audit logs
Independent management-network and host/console observers that do not depend on the resetting localhost IPMI session, including BMC reset witness/readiness checks
Owner-declared initial/final host power state; if On, OS boot ID/uptime/service continuity; if Off, continuous Off proof
Versioned expected cold-reset outage/readiness/stabilization timeouts, service checklist, expected event allowlist and escalation/recovery runbook
Protected local agent or verified secret-safe host access, maintenance window, active-management-session drain and explicit one-reset approval
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact DUT/BMC/local IPMI device and independent observers. Preserve SEL/audit evidence and capture BMC identity, MAC/IP/VLAN/channel/certificate, services/health and host power/boot baseline; drain management operations. After explicit approval issue exactly one protected local `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x02` with bounded command-response handling. Require completion 00 if the implementation returns it, then independently record BMC reset/outage evidence and poll bounded readiness—not a fixed sleep—through network identity, Get Device ID, IPMI, Redfish/WebUI and Project-required services. Compare exact MAC/IP and persistent configuration. Concurrently prove no host power transition; for On record unchanged boot ID/uptime and OS/service continuity, for Off prove it remained Off. Preserve expected/unexpected logs and stabilization evidence. Stop on any anomaly; never issue host power, warm reset or a second cold reset automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The one raw Cold Reset request is accepted, the bound BMC exhibits a genuine reset and returns within approved timeout, all required management services and health checks become ready, and identity plus MAC/IP/persistent network configuration are unchanged. The host retains its initial power state and, if On, its boot instance and services remain continuous. Only expected reset events occur and no residual fault remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target, approval, one raw 0x06/0x02 request, accepted completion, independent reset/outage and full readiness evidence, unchanged MAC/IP/configuration, functional required services and unchanged host power/boot state. Fixed 90-second sleep, ping, command acknowledgement, `mc info` alone, warm reset, host reboot or evidence from another variant cannot pass. Timeout, identity/config change, incomplete service recovery, host transition, lost observer or unexpected alarm is FAIL; missing timers/mappings is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require explicit confirmation immediately before the single cold reset after rechecking exact BMC/local-device mapping, independent recovery observers and absence of management-critical work.
Use protected local/verified access; prohibit sshpass, plaintext credentials and host-key bypass.
Preserve SEL/audit and network/config baselines; do not clear logs or rely on a post-reset snapshot without pre-state.
Keep host power/control commands denylisted. Cold BMC reset must not be replaced with host cold boot, power cycle or the adjacent warm reset.
Stop on wrong target, command ambiguity, no reset witness, readiness timeout, MAC/IP/config drift, service failure, host power/boot change or alarm. Do not retry automatically.
Any recovery reset, network mutation or host action requires new incident authorization outside the test.
expected_evidence: Staged approval, immutable DUT/BMC/local-IPMI/independent-observer identity and pinned tool/Script versions
Pre-reset BMC identity, MAC/IP/VLAN/channel/certificate, service/health, preserved logs and host power/boot baseline
Redacted raw request/completion plus timestamped independent reset/outage/readiness timeline
Post-reset exact network/config/identity comparison and functional IPMI/Redfish/WebUI/SOL/service checks
Host power plus boot-ID/uptime/service continuity or continuous-Off evidence, expected-event comparison, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the BMC does not return or any invariant changes, stop without another reset or host power action, preserve evidence and keep the host in its current safe state. Use the approved independent console/service recovery and network-configuration incident runbook under separate authorization; verify management and host health before closure and escalate any failed recovery.

external_authorities.application: Sections 20.2 and 20.3 define distinct Cold and Warm Reset commands; Cold Reset restores management-controller power-up-default internal state and is not a host power cycle.

external_authorities.application: Implements separate BMC cold/warm reset command dispatch and completion handling, supporting exact raw-path equivalence checks without replacing the Master bytes.

external_authorities.title: OpenBMC official ipmitool command guide
external_authorities.application: Lists `mc reset cold` and `mc reset warm` as distinct management-controller operations; it is supplemental and does not replace the required raw in-band command.

project_authority: The Project owner supplies BMC-specific reset support, expected downtime/readiness, required services, network/config baselines, host invariant and independent recovery path. These bounded inputs make the standard cold-reset case executable without redefining it.
